shepherds_fold.title: The Scattered Flock
shepherds_fold.text:
Shepherds huddle around a dying fire. Their flock scattered when the ash-hounds came down from the road. "Lord Morvane's beasts," the eldest mutters. "And his gate is worse."

Your company will make camp here whatever you choose.

choices.label: Search for the flock
choices.hint: Fight the ash-hounds. Win: gold and the shepherds' gift. Then rest.
choices.result: You drive off the hounds and bring the sheep home. The shepherds press a bundle into your hands.

choices.label: Ask about the castle
choices.hint: Hear what the shepherds know. Then rest.
choices.result: "The gate tower never sleeps," the eldest says. "Knights in black plate stand on the wall, cracks of fire in their armour. Cinder Knights, we call them. They shield the witches behind them, and the witches set the ground alight. Strike the ones in the back first, if you can reach them."

choices.label: Share your bread
choices.hint: Pay 40 gold. Tonight's rest heals fully.
choices.result: You share your supplies with the shepherds. Bellies full and spirits lifted, your company sleeps soundly by the fire.

choices.label: Just rest
choices.result: You nod to the shepherds and make camp beside them.

witchs_hut.title: The Hedge Witch's Bargain
witchs_hut.text:
"Your thralls are mud again," the witch says, not looking up from the pot. "No matter. Travellers always want something. So do I."

Beside the cauldron stands an iron-bound chest.

choices.label: Pay her price
choices.hint: Pay 60 gold. She gives you one item from her chest and a few coins.
choices.result: The witch weighs the coins, grins, and rummages in the chest. She tosses you one piece and a few coppers. "That's what your gold buys."

choices.label: Pay in blood
choices.hint: Every hero loses 20% of their current HP (no one dies). She gives you one item from her chest and a few coins.
choices.result: A silver needle, a drop from each of you into the pot. The brew hisses. "Fair," she says, and hands you one piece from the chest and a few coins.

choices.label: Steal her ingredients
choices.hint: Fight the witch. Win: her chest and some gold.
choices.result: The witch lies still among her broken jars. Her chest is yours.

choices.label: Leave
choices.result: You leave the witch to her pot. Her laughter follows you into the reeds.

relic_vault.text: Beyond the vault keepers lies the abbey's relic vault, untouched for a hundred years.
relic_vault.reward: Open the vault to claim its relic gear.

raiders_hoard.reward: Take the hoard: mostly coin, and two pieces of gear.

sunken_shrine.title: Sunken Shrine
sunken_shrine.text: Pilgrims left their best at this shrine before the marsh rose. The offerings are few, but well kept.
sunken_shrine.reward: Take the offerings: a few fine pieces of gear.

supply_wagons.title: Supply Wagons
supply_wagons.text: Morvane's quartermasters left the wagons to their guards. Crates of arms and armour wait under the tarps.
supply_wagons.reward: Raid the wagons: plenty of gear, little coin.

ash_on_the_wind.title: Ash on the Wind
ash_on_the_wind.speaker: Charcoal Burner
ash_on_the_wind.text: In the village square a charcoal burner sits wrapped in a blanket, his hands still black with soot. He flinches as your company approaches.

dialogue.text: "No masks. Good... Forgive me. I came out of Charwood two nights ago, and I haven't slept since."

choices.label: "You're safe here. Tell us what happened."
"Spare us the sob story. What do you want?"

dialogue.text: "Men in ash masks walked into the forest with torches. They set it burning, tree by tree, and they sang while they did it."

choices.label: "Forests burn. You of all people should know."

dialogue.text: "'Praise to the Ash Lord. The embers will rise.' Over and over. They're coming this way, past the moor. What will you do?"

choices.label: "Stop them. That's why we're on this road."
"Not our problem. We have our own war."

ash_on_the_wind.liked: "You listened, and you didn't laugh. Here, take this. I won't need it where I'm going. May it serve you better than it served me."
ash_on_the_wind.disliked: "Aye. Well. Mind the smoke on the road." He pulls the blanket tighter and turns away.

the_wardens_oath.title: The Warden's Oath
the_wardens_oath.speaker: Keep Commander
the_wardens_oath.text: The keep's commander meets you on the wall, arms folded, and blocks the stair down to the south road.

dialogue.text: "King's Bridge? No. A warden swore to hold it until the king returned. The king never did, and the warden never left. I have buried enough brave fools this year."

choices.label: "Then let us be the last ones you have to bury. Someone must cross."

dialogue.text: "Whatever stands there now does not tire and does not bleed. Why should I send you to it?"

choices.label: "Because the Ash Lord's men will cross it if we don't."
"Every guardian has a weakness. Tell us what you've seen."

dialogue.text: "And if you fall on that bridge, who carries word back to me?"

choices.label: "We won't fall. But if we do, the marsh will tell you."

the_wardens_oath.liked:
He is quiet a long moment, then steps aside. "Listen, then. Iron chains moor it to the bridge, and they feed its armour. Break a chain and it reels and loses its swing, and a rising span dies with it."

"Hold something back for the end. When the bridge starts to fall, so does its guard. It strikes three times a turn, but its plate is half what it was. Rest here tonight."
the_wardens_oath.disliked: "Then go, and the river can have you." He turns back to the wall. "Rest here tonight, at least. You will want your strength."
the_wardens_oath._epilogue: Valor tanıtımı (Ömer 2026-10-13): beğenilse de beğenilmese de son sayfa; Valor burada açılır ve 5 hediye (bir mangal) verilir (data/valor.json > campaign).
the_wardens_oath._valorLesson: Sonsözden ayrı bayrak (open-questions 450): yalnız bu sonsözün Continue'su Valor dersini açar.

epilogue.title: The Commander's Embers
epilogue.text:
At the foot of the wall he stops by the great brazier and lifts two iron urns from the coals. "Every company that leaves this keep carries these. Hold a line and live, and we light an ember. Win without losing a soul, and we light two."

"When an urn burns full, that is Valor enough to drag a fallen friend back to their feet, even with steel still swinging. By a quiet fire on the road it takes less." He sets the first urn in your hands, already burning to the brim. "One life. Spend it well."
